GenAiFunction.description: Create a Revenue Cloud quote for an initial business from an opportunity. The agent takes in an Opportunity ID as a required input and returns a Quote ID. Optional inputs include the Quote Name and the Pricebook Name. This action is to quote new business, in contrast to an amendment quote or a renewal quote, which is changing or extending existing business. A sales rep may want to create multiple quotes for an opportunity.
GenAiFunction.masterLabel: Create an Initial Quote on an Opportunity
